title: Marquee Crossing Window Selection
description: Restore canonical drag-direction marquee selection (left-to-right = window/total inclusion, right-to-left = crossing/partial inclusion) for 3D world WGPU renderer.
summary: Fixed rectangle marquee making the 3D scene disappear and hiding the selection rect. Root cause: push_solid_overlay on the same draw layer as push_scene_pass breaks the overlay interleave pass (world_prepared is None there, so scene passes on that layer are skipped while overlay UI still draws). Switched marquee fill to push_solid on the backdrop layer, matching GIS map marquee rendering. Border lines remain push_line after the scene pass watermark so they interleave correctly.
